name: Newham Autumn - British Blind Off 2023
information: **PLEASE NOTE**: This is a Blindfolded specialist competition, there will be **no regular speedsolving events** held. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. **Spectators may attend for free!** The winner of 3x3 Multi-Blind will be announced as the winner of the competition.
